title: Verify bounded EUR quick-level experience effect
changes: Record one bounded CH-0340 experience effect in the first advanced cheat group without claiming a level-up or verification of other entries.
validation: In an isolated EUR Party scene, one armed interpreter frame recorded 24 writes; after disarm and a visibly confirmed change to Montblanc and back, Marsh displayed level 5 EXP 99 instead of initial EXP 78. A same-ROM/runtime/seed/input/frame and clock no-cheat control displayed EXP 78. Both exact seeds were restored, sessions/displays closed and protected inputs stayed unchanged.

Montblanc displayed EXP 99 in the enabled run and EXP 92 in the control; the captures were at different frames and are secondary evidence. The first control script rejected an oversized input batch before executing any input; the same sequence then ran in two bounded batches.
limitations: One EUR Party scene under Wine/interpreter does not prove an actual level-up, every unit, other advanced CH entries, native Windows, physical input or original device-hook equivalence. Disarm did not undo the observed changes; restoration was separate.
